From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin cooperīre. Compare Occitan cobrir, French couvrir, and Spanish cubrir.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [kuˈβɾi]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [kuˈbɾi]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [koˈbɾiɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)
  • Rhymes: -i(ɾ)

Verb

[edit]

cobrir (first-person singular present cobreixo, first-person singular preterite cobrí, past participle cobert)

  1. (transitive) to cover
  2. (transitive) to roof
    Synonym: teular
  3. (transitive) to mount, to mate with
    Synonym: muntar (equines)
  4. (transitive) to conceal
    Synonym: amagar
  5. (intransitive, pronominal) to become overcast; to tarnish (of metal)

Occitan

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • crubir, cubrir (Limousin)
  • curbir

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Occitan cobrir, from Latin cooperīre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kuˈβɾi/
  • Rhymes: -i
  • Audio (Béarn):(file)
  • Hyphenation: co‧brir

Verb

[edit]

cobrir (transitive)

  1. to cover
    Antonym: descobrir

Old Occitan

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • cubrir, curbi

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin cooperiō, cooperīre. Gallo-Romance cognate with Old French covrir.

Verb

[edit]

cobrir

  1. to cover
    • 12th century, Bernard de Ventadour, Bel m’es can eu vei la brolha
      e.lh ram son cubert de folha
      and the branches are covered with leaves

Related terms

[edit]
  • obrir / ubrir

Descendants

[edit]
  • Occitan: cobrir

References

[edit]
  • Walther von Wartburg (1928–2002), “cooperīre”, in Französisches Etymologisches Wörterbuch, volume 2: C Q K, page 1141

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Galician-Portuguese cobrir, from Latin cooperīre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /koˈbɾi(ʁ)/ [koˈbɾi(h)], /kuˈbɾi(ʁ)/ [kuˈbɾi(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /koˈbɾi(ʁ)/ [koˈbɾi(h)], /kuˈbɾi(ʁ)/ [kuˈbɾi(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /kuˈbɾi(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /koˈbɾi(ʁ)/ [koˈbɾi(χ)], /kuˈbɾi(ʁ)/ [kuˈbɾi(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /koˈbɾi(ɻ)/, /kuˈbɾi(ɻ)/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /koˈbɾi(ʁ)/ [koˈbɾi(h)]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /kuˈbɾiɾ/ [kuˈβɾiɾ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /kuˈbɾiɾ/ [kuˈβɾiɾ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /kuˈbɾi.ɾi/ [kuˈβɾi.ɾi]

  • Hyphenation: co‧brir

Verb

[edit]

cobrir (first-person singular present cubro, third-person singular present cobre, first-person singular preterite cobri, past participle coberto)

  1. to cover (conceal or protect)
    Synonyms: ocultar, tapar
    Antonym: descobrir
